what: The five wide rounds that finish the OECD Watch register: every one of the 389 open leads, grouped into the 282 distinct events they describe, tiered and assigned to a round.

tier_key.1: a severe harm flag, and the harm falls outside a rich country
tier_key.2: a harm flag, and the harm falls outside a rich country
tier_key.3: no harm flag recorded, harm outside a rich country
tier_key.4: a severe harm flag, but the harm falls in a rich country only
tier_key.5: harm in a rich country only, no severe flag
